scenes.title: Where Did Two Trillion Vanish?
scenes.purpose: Establish the mystery and scale of the $2T collapse, contrasting the normal rally with 10 weeks of relentless decline.
scenes.visual: Hero Stage commanding 72% canvas with Catmull-Rom spline curve tracing a surge before plunging into deep drawdown; display title reveals with masked line rise; kinetic punch on key spoken phrases; continuous camera drift.

layout.portrait: Top kicker, hero focal viewport with dynamic SVG spline chart and area fill, bottom telemetry pill
layout.landscape: Left-hand editorial copy block, right-hand wide Catmull-Rom spline stage

transition_out.continuity: Camera dives forward through the chart's breach point directly into the leverage trap

scenes.title: The Borrowed Money Trap
scenes.purpose: Deconstruct leverage mechanics: how 3x debt turns a minor 2% drop into a 100% collateral wipeout and automated broker execution.
scenes.visual: Mechanical radial liquidation gauge with threshold arcs; animated needle drains rapidly from safe zone into critical red; cascading broker margin alerts slide in; automated execution stamp locks.

layout.portrait: Header, central radial liquidation gauge with dynamic needle, bottom broker execution card
layout.landscape: Left-pane mathematical breakdown, right-pane dynamic liquidation gauge

transition_out.continuity: Downward vertical wipe carrying liquidation momentum into the retail market structure

scenes.title: The Everyday Retail Panic
scenes.purpose: Dramatize the unique vulnerability of China's 90% retail market structure and the resulting order vacuum when panic spreads.
scenes.visual: Split comparison stage (splitStage); left pane anchors 90% retail share; right pane reveals buy-side liquidity dropping to zero; particle stream of sell orders cascades down the canvas.

layout.portrait: Stacked dual-pane comparison stage with central VS contrast badge and waterfall particle flow
layout.landscape: Side-by-side balanced dual comparison panes with central divider

transition_out.continuity: Upward push transition into the state intervention and macroeconomic resolution

scenes.title: Why Bailouts Couldn't Fix It
scenes.purpose: Deliver the overarching thesis: state bailouts cannot print confidence, resolving on the monumental -$2.4T total equity loss and core lesson.
scenes.visual: Monumental statistical card (monumentStat); extra-large rolling counter rolls smoothly to -$2.4T; animated grounding rule settles; subtle breathing glow holds steadily through the final 2 seconds.

layout.portrait: Centered monumental card with massive counter, animated dividing rule, and grounded takeaway
layout.landscape: Centered expansive monument card with wide typographic balance

transition_out.continuity: Final monumental card holds motionless with gentle breathing focus until completion
